description: This PHP file defines the class I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams, which extends FilterParams and encapsulates various filtering parameters for internationalization translation searches within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like languageId, sourceText, translatedText, groupId, and onlyTranslated, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Subclass of FilterParams used for specifying search filters related to internationalization translations, including language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and translation status flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'langString.value'.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language for the translation search filter.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID for the translation search filter.

methods.name: getSourceText
methods.description: Retrieves the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: setSourceText
methods.description: Sets the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: getTranslatedText
methods.description: Retrieves the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: setTranslatedText
methods.description: Sets the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with the translation filter.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the group ID for the translation filter.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Checks whether the filter is limited to only translated entries.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets the flag to filter only translated entries.
